name: Pane-Ascetic

Traits.name: Resonant Riposte
Traits.text: Whenever it is hit by a melee attack, the pane-ascetic's surface rings with resonance, granting it Advantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
Traits.clause: The pane-ascetic's body is a lattice of living glass that remembers every blow — whenever it is hit by a melee attack, i
Traits.expresses: reflecting every blow back on the striker

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The pane-ascetic makes two attacks, using Unarmed Strike or Dart in any combination.

Actions.name: Unarmed Strike
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. 27 (5d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. Once on each of the pane-ascetic's turns when it hits with this attack, the target is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 17. *Failure:* The target has the Stunned condition until the end of the pane-ascetic's next turn.

Actions.name: Dart
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, range 20/60 ft. 29 (6d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Patient Defense
Bonus Actions.text: The pane-ascetic takes the Dodge action.

Bonus Actions.name: Cunning Action
Bonus Actions.text: The pane-ascetic takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

lore: Fired from a monastery of self-mortifying ascetics into a single flawless pane, the risen glass now walks the battlefield counting every blow it takes so it can repay it in kind.

generation.userConcept: a glass monk who turns every blow back on whoever struck it

clauses.text: turns every blow back on whoever struck it
